sources.title: David Heineman
sources.snippet: I've developed new and efficient tools for measuring model behavior [4, 5], and built receipes for fully-open language models [6, 7]. Recently, I've been thinking about how methods from pretraining can help us build vision-language, speech-language and reasoning models.
